verdict.rationale: Sentry's own AI debugging agent, Seer, documents Autofix, which automatically scans incoming issues and finds root causes. It draws on issue details, tracing data, logs and profiles, and can go further by generating a fix PR. This directly delivers AI investigation of an error that proposes a probable root cause. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of root-cause accuracy, and in-depth documentation of how the investigation and output work (including explicit alert-triggered investigations).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
Find root causes and fix production issues with [Seer, our debugging agent]
It uses Sentry's rich context (issue details, tracing data, logs, and profiles) to help you troubleshoot and fix errors and performance issues faster.
